summary: The as-built document works on existing environments, and updates report their state correctly.

fixes.title: As-built document works on existing environments
fixes.text: The as-built document could not be made on environments set up by the nightly update. It now works, and its log names the fix if it still cannot run.
fixes.action: An Owner of the PIM resource group runs the hosting access setup script once; the update log reminds you until then.

fixes.title: Updates no longer report false problems
fixes.text: The update no longer reports the as-built document job as not fully updated right after moving it, and it waits briefly when that job is still busy.
